scenes.headline: How Muse Glimmer fits an agent in 24 GB
scenes.sub: Meta's open-weight agent model, designed around one consumer GPU.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Twinkle! Muse Glimmer is Meta's thirty-billion-parameter agent model, built for one consumer graphics card. Here's how it fits.

scenes.label: Designed backwards
scenes.text: Start from the memory budget: weights, a 131K-token KV cache, a vision encoder and a drafter must all fit in 24 GB at once.
scenes.say: The idea: design backwards from memory. The weights, a long-context cache, a vision encoder and a drafter all have to fit in twenty-four gigabytes at once.

steps.say: Four-bit quantization shrinks the language model to sixteen point seven six gigabytes.
Beside it: a vision encoder, a speculative drafter, and the KV cache at full context.
Together that's twenty-one point six gigabytes, with two point four to spare. The claim is arithmetic.

scenes.title: Three local layers, then one global

steps.label: Local layers: a 2048-token window
steps.note: RoPE on the local layers only
steps.say: Three of every four layers are local. Each token looks back two thousand and forty-eight tokens, so their cache stops growing.

steps.label: Global layers: the whole context
steps.note: 13 of 52 layers, with no positional encoding
steps.say: Every fourth layer is global and sees everything, with no positional encoding. The argument: then longer contexts hold no surprises.

scenes.title: Why the pattern is the reason it fits

left.title: All 52 layers global
left.say: Make all fifty-two layers global, and the cache grows to six point nine eight gigabytes. It no longer fits.

right.title: Three local, one global
right.say: Three local per global, plus sixteen-to-one grouped queries, keep it at one point eight three.

items.say: A five-layer drafter proposes sixteen tokens in one forward pass.
The main model verifies them in parallel.
Decoding reads every weight for each token. Verifying sixteen at once shares that read.
So the gain tracks spare compute: three point one times on an RTX fifty-ninety, one point five on an M4 Max.

scenes.text: Sliding windows, grouped queries and 4-bit weights aren't three optimizations. They are one budget, allocated.
scenes.say: Sliding windows, grouped queries and four-bit weights aren't three optimizations. They're one memory budget, allocated.

recap: Weights, cache, encoder and drafter: 21.6 of 24 GB
Three local layers per global keep the cache small
A 16-token drafter spends spare compute on speed
scenes.say: To recap: a budget that closes, sliding windows keeping the cache small, and a drafter spending spare compute.
